messages:
Ashley: FYI Acme POC seeing 429s during a parallel upload test ~45s in. Logs (redacted): https://acme-demo.logs/recent

Samir: can you paste the error + response headers? 429s usually mean per-route RPM or token-rate limits.

acme-agent: Customer error: "{\"error\":\"Too many requests\",\"status\":429}"
Response headers: x-ratelimit-limit: 60, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 12

Miguel (oncall): default /v1/generate = 60 rpm short window. Were they running many parallel workers?

Ashley: yes — 8 concurrent staging workers, each ~1 req/s, runs ~60s. Payloads ~1200 tokens avg.

Jia: quick math: ~480 requests in that window. Per-route 60 rpm will cap them before token budget. Also check per-minute token rate: 8 * 1 r/s * 1200 tokens ~ 9600 tokens/s -> 576k tokens/min? wait that math is off; re-evaluating: 8 r/s * 1200 tokens = 9600 tokens/s -> 576k tokens/min. Definitely token-rate could also matter if set low.

rate-limiter-bot: Quota snapshot for org "acme-corp": monthly_token_budget=5,000,000; tokens_used_mtd=1,100,432; per_minute_token_rate_limit=20000; per_route_requests_per_minute(/v1/generate)=60.

Miguel: both limits relevant but per-route 60 rpm is the immediate blocker. Sales asked for temporary bump to 150 rpm and 30000 tokens/min while POC runs.

Samir: applying targeted bump now:
redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --rpm 150 --token-rate 30000 --note "trial bump for Acme POC"
(Change q-98011)

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org "acme-corp" (change q-98011). New per-route rpm=150. New token_rate_limit=30000 tokens/min.

Ashley: asked customer to re-run test. They posted this short log: 
[2026-05-02T11:10:32Z] POST /v1/generate 200 1180 tokens
[2026-05-02T11:10:33Z] POST /v1/generate 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0

Miguel: one-off 429 likely due to propagation/window-edge race. Recommend adding temporary burst allowance to absorb startup parallelism.

Jia: propose burst_capacity=250 over 30s and remind client to use jittered backoff to avoid synchronized retries.

Samir: applying burst patch:
redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --burst_capacity 250 --burst_window 30
(Change q-98012)

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated for org "acme-corp" (change q-98012). burst_capacity=250, burst_window=30s.

acme-agent: customer reran: "errors dropped to near zero, big improvement" :tada:

Miguel: SRE note for playbook: for sales POCs with parallel workers recommend starting settings rpm=120-200, token-rate=25k-50k tokens/min, burst_capacity=200-400/30s and client-side jittered exponential backoff.

Jia: filing INF-4599 to add a sales-facing quota-bump template (includes audit log and auto-expiry).

Samir: audit: q-98011 and q-98012 recorded; policy auto-expiry in 7 days unless Ash requests extension.

Ashley: will follow up if Acme asks to extend. marking this resolved on our side. thanks team <3

Miguel: monitoring for 2 hours and will alert if error rate increases.

rate-limiter-bot: Monitoring: org "acme-corp" 1-min error rate decreased from 16% -> 0.9%.
